Powerful Local Inference
Offering 24 GB of dedicated memory, up to 456 GB/s bandwidth and 160 XMX AI engines, Intel® Arc™ Pro B60 GPUs are tailored for the increased memory usage and processing demands required by modern professional projects like AI, generative design, 3D simulation, ray tracing, and editing tasks.
Scalable AI Performance
Gain scalable performance with Linux multi-GPU LLM support from the Intel® Arc™ Pro B60 GPU, optimized to run larger, more advanced AI for higher quality and faster outputs.
Optimized Software.
ISV Certified.
Ensure reliable, precise performance for common AI, design, engineering, architectural, and manufacturing software with a workstation-focused, validated, and robust graphics driver. Paired with trusted ISV (Independent Software Vendor) certified 1 Intel® Arc™ Pro B60 GPU hardware benefits, the professional graphics driver substantially boosts raw performance over the standard Intel® graphics driver across a broad range of APIs.
A Versatile Creator Toolkit
Save time and export videos quickly with twin media transcoders supporting dual-encode.
Create content with support for the most popular media formats including cutting-edge AV1.
The powerful Xe media engine enables you to create and edit content quickly in high-res.
Performance varies by use, configuration, and other factors. Learn more at www.Intel.com/PerformanceIndex. Intel® technologies may require enabled hardware, software or service activation. No product or component can be absolutely secure. Your costs and results may vary.
